description.en: Official code and dataset resources for self-supervised spatial-audio generation from 360-degree video.
description.zh: 从 360 度视频进行自监督空间音频生成的官方代码与数据资源。

description.en: Training and evaluation code for visually guided mono-to-binaural generation and the FAIR-Play dataset.
description.zh: 视觉引导单声道到双耳音频生成及 FAIR-Play 数据集的训练与评测代码。

description.en: Training, evaluation, pretrained models, and recorded data for neural mono-to-binaural speech rendering.
description.zh: 神经单声道到双耳语音渲染的训练、评测、预训练模型与录音数据。

description.en: Official implementation of self-supervised stereophonic generation with visual source-separation cues.
description.zh: 结合视觉声源分离线索进行自监督立体声生成的官方实现。

description.en: Official code for visually informed binaural generation trained without real binaural recordings.
description.zh: 无需真实双耳录音训练的视觉引导双耳音频生成官方代码。

description.en: Dataset, baseline scripts, and evaluation resources for sound-field interpolation and synthesis on meshed grids.
description.zh: 面向网格声场插值与合成的数据、基线脚本及评测资源。

description.en: Implementation of multi-task mono-to-binaural audio generation.
description.zh: 多任务单声道到双耳音频生成实现。

description.en: Code for direction-conditioned global interpolation of personalized HRTFs.
description.zh: 面向个体化 HRTF 的方向条件全局插值代码。

description.en: BinauralGrad implementation within NeuralSpeech for conditional diffusion-based binaural synthesis.
description.zh: NeuralSpeech 中基于条件扩散的双耳音频合成 BinauralGrad 实现。

description.en: Autoencoder implementation for HRTF interpolation from sparse measurements with source-position conditioning.
description.zh: 使用声源位置条件从稀疏测量插值 HRTF 的自编码器实现。

description.en: Neural-field representation and interpolation code for measured HRTF magnitudes.
description.zh: 测量 HRTF 幅度的神经场表征与插值代码。

description.en: Official implementation of position-conditioned binaural speech rendering in the Fourier domain.
description.zh: 傅里叶域位置条件双耳语音渲染的官方实现。

description.en: Code and data preparation for novel-position audio-visual scene synthesis with neural fields.
description.zh: 使用神经场在新位置合成音视频场景的代码与数据准备工具。

description.en: GAN-based HRTF upsampling implementation using a gnomonic equiangular projection.
description.zh: 基于球心等角投影和生成对抗网络的 HRTF 上采样实现。

description.en: Physics-informed neural network implementation for spatial HRTF upsampling.
description.zh: 用于 HRTF 空间上采样的物理信息神经网络实现。

description.en: Official dataset schema, access instructions, and loading resources for the Spatial LibriSpeech corpus.
description.zh: Spatial LibriSpeech 语料库的官方数据结构、获取说明与加载资源。

description.en: Neural IIR filter fields for HRTF upsampling and personalization.
description.zh: 用于 HRTF 上采样与个性化的神经 IIR 滤波器场。

description.en: Official implementation of neural upmixing from lower-channel audio to Ambisonics.
description.zh: 从较少声道音频神经上混至 Ambisonics 的官方实现。

description.en: Zero-shot pipeline for generating and spatializing sound from visual environments.
description.zh: 根据视觉环境生成并空间化声音的零样本流程。

description.en: Code and resources for language-driven binaural soundscape generation with spatial control.
description.zh: 具有空间控制的语言驱动双耳声景生成代码与资源。

description.en: Official implementation of contextual and contrastive audio-visual learning for binaural generation.
description.zh: 用于双耳生成的上下文与对比式音视频学习官方实现。

description.en: Official code and dataset tools for generating spatial audio from 360-degree video.
description.zh: 从 360 度视频生成空间音频的官方代码与数据工具。

description.en: Code and models for multimodal generation of continuous multi-speaker binaural drama.
description.zh: 多模态连续多说话人双耳剧集生成的代码与模型。

description.en: Official implementation and YT-Ambigen resources for video-to-Ambisonics generation.
description.zh: 视频到 Ambisonics 生成的官方实现及 YT-Ambigen 资源。

description.en: Python toolbox for analyzing HRTFs and spatial-audio perceptual experiments, released with the extended SONICOM resource.
description.zh: 用于分析 HRTF 与空间音频感知实验的 Python 工具箱，与扩展 SONICOM 资源一同发布。

description.en: Open Ambisonic production plug-ins for encoding, reverberation, dynamics, rotation, visualization, and decoding.
description.zh: 面向 Ambisonics 制作的开放插件套件，涵盖编码、混响、动态、旋转、可视化与解码。

description.en: Open plug-in suite for producing, analyzing, and reproducing spatial sound scenes.
description.zh: 用于空间声场制作、分析与重放的开放插件套件。

description.en: Cross-platform C framework for spatial-audio processing and reproduction algorithms.
description.zh: 面向空间音频处理与重放算法的跨平台 C 框架。

description.en: EBU plug-ins and tools for authoring and monitoring ADM object-, scene-, and channel-based audio.
description.zh: 用于制作和监听 ADM 对象、场景及声道音频的 EBU 插件与工具。

description.en: EBU binaural renderer for ADM object-, direct-speaker-, and Higher-Order Ambisonic content.
description.zh: 面向 ADM 对象、直接扬声器及高阶 Ambisonics 内容的 EBU 双耳渲染器。

description.en: C++ library for Ambisonic encoding, rotation, decoding, binauralization, and object rendering.
description.zh: 提供 Ambisonics 编码、旋转、解码、双耳化与对象渲染的 C++ 库。

description.en: Cross-platform Ambisonic plug-ins for digital audio workstations and standalone use.
description.zh: 用于数字音频工作站及独立运行的跨平台 Ambisonics 插件。
